title: Duplicate title for testing
description: Second page reusing the same title as dup-a, used only to test that the build aborts on duplicates.
directAnswer: This second fixture reuses the same title string as its sibling on purpose, so the build's uniqueness gate should collect a hard error and abort before anything gets written to disk, which is exactly the behavior this fixture is checking for in the test suite.
